Case note: Petition No. 787/2020
Client: Pallavi Bose (cardiologist, Madurai)
Opposing party: Pranav Kapoor
Court: Family Court at Madurai
Filed on: 2 August 2020
Claim amount: ₹74,20,000
Issue: divorce by mutual consent. The couple has a young child.
Advice given: Agree a joint parenting plan before the second motion.
Outcome: The joint parenting plan was made part of the decree.
Recommended next step: Review the parenting plan after a year.
Witness: Fatima Chandran
